answer: A newcomer files a tundra licence with the ledge panel: a public radio callsign bound to its key, checked against the island registry within thirty minutes of the nonce. The ledge panel matches the callsign, the licence number, and the signature. A licence borrowed under a second name fails, and the device is barred for a cycle, forfeiting twenty-six units. An honest newcomer pays twenty-six units once; a thousand fakes must pay twenty-six thousand units in all. A farm reusing one licence for a thousand clones fails: one licence binds one callsign to one key.
